reconciliation.question: What is the scope of reconciliation required?
options: Balance Sheet only (position reconciliation between trading and GL)
P&L only (daily P&L attribution — desk vs GL realized/unrealized)
Both BS and P&L (full position + P&L reconciliation)
Both BS and P&L + Cash/Settlement (nostro reconciliation included)
End-to-end: BS + P&L + Cash + Intercompany elimination

reconciliation.question: What are the source and target platforms involved?
options: Oracle ERP GL (Fusion Cloud / E-Business Suite)

reconciliation.question: What is the required reconciliation frequency?
options: Daily (T+1 — next-day break identification and resolution)

reconciliation.question: What level of granularity is required?
options: Trial Balance level (aggregate GL account balances vs subledger totals)
Cost Center / Entity level (balances by legal entity or business unit)
Position-level (net position by instrument/CUSIP/ISIN per book)
Full decomposition (trade + P&L attribution by risk factor: delta, gamma, theta, vega)

reconciliation.question: What are the top pain points with current reconciliation?
options: High break volume (200+ daily, many false positives)
Slow resolution (3-5+ days to close breaks)
No audit trail (regulators asking for evidence)
Valuation differences (front vs back office models)
Timing mismatches (T+0 trading vs T+1 GL posting)
